bitmap-3.name: Bitmap
bitmap-3.description: The core UI set rendered on a coarse pixel lattice — whole square pixels only, staircase diagonals, not one curve in the family.

gaffer-2.name: Gaffer
gaffer-2.description: Every icon torn from tape and pressed down by hand — straight strips at crooked angles, ragged ends and honest overlaps.

bitmap-2.description: The core UI set rendered on a coarse pixel lattice — whole square pixels only, staircase diagonals, not one curve in the family.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.description: A calm rounded outline family for health products — anatomy, clinics, diagnostics, fitness and everyday wellbeing.

constellation.name: Constellation
constellation.description: A night-atlas icon family charted rather than drawn — every glyph is a constellation of bright star-dots joined by thin chart lines, for astronomy, sleep and wonder products.

stack.name: Stack
stack.description: An engineered outline icon family for developer, cloud and data products — code, infrastructure, networking, pipelines, devops and hardware.

cross-stitch-gpt2.name: Cross Stitch · GPT Image 2
cross-stitch-gpt2.description: A cosy home icon family sewn rather than drawn — every contour is a running line of stitches on an implied fabric weave.

whiskers.name: Whiskers
whiskers.description: A pet-app icon family where every single glyph has quietly grown a cat part — ears, a tail, a paw or whiskers.

meltdown-gpt2.name: Meltdown · GPT Image 2
meltdown-gpt2.description: A UI icon family caught mid-melt — every glyph sags, pools and drips, for festival, summer and heatwave products.

drafting-table-nb2.name: Drafting Table · Nano Banana 2 (Flash)
drafting-table-nb2.description: An engineering icon set drawn as a CAD detail — each part sits inside its own centre lines, extension lines and dimension arrows.

ui-essentials.name: UI Essentials
ui-essentials.description: A geometric outline icon family covering the core UI vocabulary — navigation, actions, media, commerce and more.
